answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1617 Country: Bangladesh Title: I am a 20 yo girl engaged to a 25y person, and we planned to get married on july, he came 4 that, but my parents refuse now because he is not very rich, they want a huge muhr, and huge wedding... can i get married to him without their permission? Question: I am a 20 yo girl engaged to a 25y person, and we planned to get married on july, he came 4 that, but my parents refuse now because he is not very rich, they want a huge muhr, and huge wedding... can i get married to him without their permission? Answer ID: 1617 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 935/935=J) If you marry the boy without the consent of you parents, the nikah will be valid; you and the boy will be halal for each other, but in Islamic society it is disliked to marry without a guardian: قال النبی صلی اللہ علیہ و سلم: لا نکاح الا بولیٍّ، رواہ أحمد، والترمذی، وأبوداؤد، و ابن ماجۃ والدارمی (مشکوۃ المصابیح: 370) Therefore, it is advisable for you not to marry the boy rather communicate your parents by the mediation of your friends to send proposal of marriage to the same boy. You should convey that though the boy is not so rich but you like him. The parents also should consider the liking of their daughter; although, they boy is lower in family status but they should get their daughter married to him. The approval of girl should not be undermined only just for the sake of huge mahr and wedding ceremonies. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
